system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 1 hour, 8 Spell Uses. Lasts: 6 hours. Summons a bright red, horned lesser fae the size of a human newborn with a prehensile tail. It begrudgingly obeys but can't fight. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
